_comment: What skstate init merges into .claude/settings.json. It never overwrites: existing deny rules and hooks are kept, these are added alongside. What was inserted is recorded in .openskillstate/installed.json so re-running init replaces instead of duplicating, uninstall removes only client integration, and deinit can remove the project completely (ADR 0012). Claude Code path permissions are checked against Edit(path) and Read(path); Write(path) rules are not consulted for file paths. The leading slash anchors this rule to the primary working directory in project settings (ADR 0009).
